description.strong: Fullstack Developer with +3 years of experience
description.rest: , working with React, Python, Node.js and cloud technologies.

infosapiens.description1: Developing and implementing microservices architecture using Python, Node.js and Azure technologies, improving application scalability and maintainability.
infosapiens.description2: Designing microfrontend solutions with React and Angular, facilitating modularization and independent team collaboration.
infosapiens.description3: Implementing DevOps practices using Azure DevOps and Azure Repos for effective code management and participating in technical architecture decisions.

gobierno.description1: Migrated legacy applications to Docker, reducing infrastructure costs by 30% and VM instances by 60%.
gobierno.description2: Led backend migration to NestJS with TypeORM and SQL Server, implementing domain-driven design principles for a more maintainable architecture.
gobierno.description3: Established GitLab server for version control and introduced modern front-end technologies (Next.js, Tailwind CSS) improving security and maintainability.

masoft.description1: Developed Gastos Passa, an internal expense management system with Meteor.js, React, Zustand, and SQL Server, optimizing financial operations.
masoft.description2: Created responsive showcase website for BYD vehicles using Next.js, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS with integrated email and WhatsApp functionalities.
masoft.description3: Implemented Dockerization and Git workflows across various web projects to modernize development processes and improve delivery timelines.

technologies.description1: Built custom web solutions for small and medium-sized businesses using Express/Node and React.
technologies.description2: Created intuitive and responsive interfaces with Material UI and React for improved user experience.
technologies.description3: Optimized project performance through migration to cutting-edge technologies like Next.js and Astro.

passa.title: Refound System - Passa
passa.description: A system that allows accountants and employees to manage the refund process in Agricola Passa. The client wanted to use Meteor with React to develop the system.

bydPremier.title: BYD - Premier
bydPremier.description: A demonstration page developed for a car brand, featuring showcase sections, interactive forms, location maps, and a dedicated contact section.
